questions.title: Finding the Second Moment and Variance from a Probability Table

parts.text:
A discrete random variable $X$ has the probability distribution shown in the table:
$$\begin{array}{c|ccc} x & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ \hline P(X = x) & 0.2 & 0.5 & 0.3 \end{array}$$
Given that $E(X) = 2.4$, find the value of $E(X^2)$ and hence calculate $\text{Var}(X)$.

questions.title: Squaring Negative Outcomes to Find Variance

parts.text: A discrete random variable $X$ takes values $-2$, $1$, and $4$ with probabilities $0.3$, $0.4$, and $0.3$ respectively. Find $E(X)$ and show that $\text{Var}(X) = 5.4$.

questions.title: Moments of a Quadratic Probability Mass Function

parts.text: A discrete random variable $X$ takes values $1$, $2$, and $3$ with $P(X = x) = kx^2$. Given that $k = \frac{1}{14}$ and $E(X) = \frac{18}{7}$, find the exact value of $\text{Var}(X)$.

questions.title: Extracting Standard Deviation from Mean and Second Moment

parts.text: For a discrete random variable $X$, it is given that $E(X) = 2.2$ and $E(X^2) = 7.4$. Calculate the variance and the standard deviation of $X$, giving the standard deviation correct to 3 significant figures.

questions.title: Variance of a Non-Standard Four-Sided Die

parts.text: A four-sided die has faces numbered $1, 1, 2, 4$, each equally likely to land face down. Let $X$ be the number shown on the face landed down. Find $E(X)$ and $\text{Var}(X)$.

questions.title: Exact Variance of a Standard Fair Die

parts.text: A standard fair 6-sided die has faces numbered $1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6$. Let $X$ be the number shown when the die is rolled. Given that $E(X) = \frac{7}{2}$, find the exact value of $\text{Var}(X)$.

questions.title: Complete Variance and Standard Deviation from Tabular Distribution

parts.text:
A discrete random variable $X$ has the probability distribution shown in the table:
$$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ \hline P(X = x) & 0.2 & 0.3 & 0.4 & 0.1 \end{array}$$
Calculate $E(X)$ and $E(X^2)$.
Hence calculate $\text{Var}(X)$ and the standard deviation of $X$, giving the standard deviation correct to 3 significant figures.

questions.title: Unknown Probability Parameter and Standard Deviation

parts.text:
A discrete random variable $X$ has the probability distribution given by:
$$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & -2 & 0 & 1 & 3 \\ \hline P(X = x) & 0.1 & 0.4 & p & 0.2 \end{array}$$
Find the value of $p$, and show that $E(X) = 0.7$.
Calculate the variance and the standard deviation of $X$, giving the standard deviation correct to 3 significant figures.

questions.title: Sampling Without Replacement: Moments and Spread

parts.text: A bag contains 4 red counters and 3 blue counters. Two counters are drawn at random without replacement. Let $X$ denote the number of red counters drawn. Construct the probability distribution table of $X$, and find $E(X)$.
Find the exact value of $\text{Var}(X)$, and find the standard deviation of $X$ correct to 3 significant figures.

questions.title: Symmetric Quadratic PMF: Normalisation and Moment Proof

parts.text: A discrete random variable $X$ takes the integer values $1, 2, 3, 4, 5$, and its probability mass function is given by $P(X = x) = kx(6 - x)$. Find the value of $k$ and show that $E(X) = 3$.
Show that $\text{Var}(X) = 1.60$, and find the standard deviation of $X$ correct to 3 significant figures.

questions.title: Expectation and Variance of a Game of Chance Net Payout

parts.text: In a game of chance, a player pays \$3 to spin a pointer. The pointer stops on sections numbered $1, 2, 3, 4$ with probabilities $0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1$ respectively. The player receives a payout of \$2x^2, where $x$ is the number shown. Let $Y$ denote the net gain in dollars ($Y = 2x^2 - 3$). Tabulate the probability distribution of $Y$, and calculate $E(Y)$.
Find $\text{Var}(Y)$ and the standard deviation of the net gain, giving the standard deviation correct to 3 significant figures.

questions.title: Absolute Difference of Two Dice: Distribution, Moments, and Interval

parts.text:
Two fair 4-sided dice, each with faces numbered $1, 2, 3, 4$, are thrown together. The random variable $X$ is the positive difference between the two numbers shown, so $X = |D_1 - D_2|$. Show that the probability distribution table for $X$ is:
$$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline P(X = x) & \frac{4}{16} & \frac{6}{16} & \frac{4}{16} & \frac{2}{16} \end{array}$$
Calculate $E(X)$, and find the exact value of $\text{Var}(X)$.
Find the standard deviation $\sigma$ of $X$ correct to 3 significant figures, and calculate the probability that $X$ lies within one standard deviation of its mean, $P(|X - E(X)| < \sigma)$.

questions.title: Hypergeometric Sampling: Moments and Quadratic Cost Function

parts.text:
A box contains 10 electronic components, of which exactly 3 are defective and 7 are non-defective. A quality-control inspector selects a random sample of 3 components without replacement. Let $X$ be the number of defective components in the sample. Show that the probability distribution table of $X$ is:
$$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline P(X = x) & \frac{35}{120} & \frac{63}{120} & \frac{21}{120} & \frac{1}{120} \end{array}$$
Calculate $E(X)$, $\text{Var}(X)$, and the standard deviation of $X$.
The testing laboratory incurs a cost of $C$ dollars for inspecting the sample, where $C = 50 + 20X^2$. Find the expected total cost $E(C)$.
